1_Cleaning

Victor Brun

2023-02-21

1. Data & packages

rm(list=ls())

library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(fishualize)
library(sjPlot)

# Loading data

df_cons <- read_xlsx("./../Data/Consumption_SFB.xlsx", sheet = 1) # Consumption data
df_hous <- read_xlsx("./../Data/Consumption_SFB.xlsx", sheet = 2) # Metadata on households for consumption data
df_itw <- read_xlsx("./../Data/Consumption_interview.xlsx", sheet = 1) # Qualitative interviews of locals on consumption
df_fishers <- read_xlsx("./../Data/Fisherfolks.xlsx", sheet = 1) # Census of active fishers
df_landings <- read_xlsx("./../Data/Fishing_sessions.xlsx", sheet = 1) # Data on fishing landings
df_sessions <- read_xlsx("./../Data/Fishing_sessions.xlsx", sheet = 2) # Data on fishing sessions
df_lm <- read_xlsx("./../Data/Length_mass.xlsx", sheet = 1) # List of species caught in the bay and length mass data

# Left join to add metadata to consumption data
df_cons <- df_cons %>% 
  select(-ID_survey) %>% 
  left_join(df_hous, by = "Questionnaire")

# Left join to add metadata to fish landings
df_landings <- df_landings %>% left_join(df_sessions, by = "ID")

2. Data format

# Consumption
df_cons[, c(1:6, 11:12)] <- lapply(df_cons[, c(1:6, 11:12)], factor)
df_cons[, c(7:11, 14:35)] <- lapply(df_cons[, c(7:11, 14:35)], as.numeric)

# Households
df_hous[, c(1:6, 8, 9, 14:20, 24:30)] <- lapply(df_hous[, c(1:6, 8, 9, 14:20, 24:30)], factor)
df_hous[, c(7, 10:13, 21:23)] <- lapply(df_hous[, c(7, 10:13, 21:23)], as.numeric)

# Interviews
df_itw[, c(1:5, 7:54)] <- lapply(df_itw[, c(1:5, 7:54)], factor)

# Fisherfolks
df_fishers[, c(1:7, 9:19, 21, 22, 24:26, 28)] <- lapply(df_fishers[, c(1:7, 9:19, 21, 22, 24:26, 28)], factor)
df_fishers[, c(8, 20, 23, 27)] <- lapply(df_fishers[, c(8, 20, 23, 27)], as.numeric)

# Landings
df_landings[, 1:4] <- lapply(df_landings[, 1:4], factor)
df_landings[, 5:7] <- lapply(df_landings[, 5:7], as.numeric)

# Sessions
df_sessions[, c(1, 3:12, 16, 19, 20, 23, 24, 27)] <- lapply(df_sessions[, c(1, 3:12, 16, 19, 20, 23, 24, 27)] , factor)
df_sessions[, 2] <- lapply(df_sessions[, 2], as.Date)
df_sessions[, c(13:15, 17, 18, 21, 22, 25, 26)] <- lapply(df_sessions[, c(13:15, 17, 18, 21, 22, 25, 26)], as.numeric)

5. Dataviz fisheries

## Gears used (census)
df_fishers %>%
  select(Barangay, Year, Gear_1, Gear_2, Gear_3) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Gear_1, Gear_2, Gear_3), names_to = "Gear_number", values_to = "Gear") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Gear)) %>%
  group_by(Year, Barangay) %>%
  count(Gear, name = "N") %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(Gear != "Blast", Gear != "Cyanide") %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x = Barangay, y = N, fill = Gear)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(vars(Year)) +
  labs(x = "", y ="Number of gears") +
  theme_minimal()

## Habitats fished
df_fishers %>%
  select(Barangay, Year, Hab_1, Hab_2) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Hab_1, Hab_2), names_to = "Habitat_number", values_to = "Habitat") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Habitat)) %>%
  group_by(Year, Barangay) %>%
  count(Habitat, name = "N") %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x = Barangay, y = N, fill = Habitat)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(vars(Year)) +
  labs(x = "", y ="Number of fishers") +
  theme_minimal()

##  Fishing effort
df_fishers %>% 
  select(Year, Barangay, Fishing_days) %>%
  group_by(Year, Barangay) %>% 
  summarise(Effort = sum(Fishing_days), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = Barangay, y = Effort, fill = Year)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(x = "", y = "Effort (fishing days)") +
  theme_minimal()

## CPUE

# Dataset
df_hook <- df_sessions %>%
  filter(Gear == "Hook and line" & Method == "Bait", 
         Habitat_1 %in% c("Batas", "Depla", "Mabini", "Sandoval", "Silanga"),
         !is.na(Time_fish),
         !is.na(Capture_kg)) %>%
  mutate(CPUE = Capture_kg/Time_fish)

# Boxplot CPUE per village
df_hook %>% ggplot(., aes(x = Habitat_1, y = CPUE, fill = Habitat_1)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = .6) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = .3, width = .2) +
  labs(x = "", y = "CPUE", fill = "Fished habitat") +
  scale_fill_fish_d(option = "Balistapus_undulatus") +
  theme_minimal()

summary(aov(CPUE ~ Habitat_1, data = df_hook))
##              Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)    
## Habitat_1     4  63.16  15.789   27.56 <2e-16 ***
## Residuals   451 258.38   0.573                   
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
TukeyHSD(aov(CPUE ~ Habitat_1, data = df_hook))
##   Tukey multiple comparisons of means
##     95% family-wise confidence level
## 
## Fit: aov(formula = CPUE ~ Habitat_1, data = df_hook)
## 
## $Habitat_1
##                         diff         lwr         upr     p adj
## Depla-Batas      -0.72280701 -0.97101737 -0.47459665 0.0000000
## Mabini-Batas     -0.47600669 -0.97116760  0.01915422 0.0661988
## Sandoval-Batas   -0.94425514 -1.23879169 -0.64971858 0.0000000
## Silanga-Batas     0.02327151 -0.39486557  0.44140860 0.9998785
## Mabini-Depla      0.24680032 -0.22828717  0.72188782 0.6132539
## Sandoval-Depla   -0.22144813 -0.48082350  0.03792725 0.1347846
## Silanga-Depla     0.74607853  0.35191812  1.14023893 0.0000033
## Sandoval-Mabini  -0.46824845 -0.96909925  0.03260235 0.0795832
## Silanga-Mabini    0.49927820 -0.08290594  1.08146234 0.1316573
## Silanga-Sandoval  0.96752665  0.54266688  1.39238643 0.0000000
pairwise.t.test(df_hook$CPUE, df_hook$Habitat_1, p.adj="none")
## 
##  Pairwise comparisons using t tests with pooled SD 
## 
## data:  df_hook$CPUE and df_hook$Habitat_1 
## 
##          Batas   Depla   Mabini Sandoval
## Depla    1.3e-14 -       -      -       
## Mabini   0.0088  0.1555  -      -       
## Sandoval < 2e-16 0.0198  0.0108 -       
## Silanga  0.8789  3.3e-07 0.0193 1.0e-09 
## 
## P value adjustment method: none
# CPUE in time
ggplot(data = df_hook, aes(x = Date, y = CPUE)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  theme_minimal()
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

# CPUE in time (per village)
ggplot(data = df_hook, aes(x = Date, y = CPUE, col = Habitat_1)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "", y = "CPUE (kg/h)", col = "Village fished") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  scale_color_fish_d(option = "Coris_gaimard") +
  theme_minimal()
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'

6. Dataviz consumption

## Adding variables to consumption data
# Size of household
df_hous$N_household <- df_hous$N_adults_hh+df_hous$N_children_hh

# Livelihood of household: fisher, farmer, fisher & farmer,  other livelihood
df_hous <- df_hous %>%
  mutate(Fisher = case_when(if_any(starts_with("Job"), ~ .x == "Fishing") ~ "Yes"),
         Farmer = case_when(if_any(starts_with("Job"), ~ .x == "Farming") ~ "Yes"),
         Fisher_farmer = case_when(if_all(c(Fisher, Farmer), ~ .x == "Yes") ~ "Yes"),
         Other_livelihood = case_when(if_all(c(Fisher, Farmer, Fisher_farmer), ~ is.na(.x)) ~ "Yes"),
         Livelihood_x = case_when(Fisher == "Yes" ~ "Fisher",
                                Farmer == "Yes" ~ "Farmer",
                                Other_livelihood == "Yes" ~ "Other livelihood"),
         Livelihood = case_when(Fisher_farmer == "Yes" ~ "Fisher & farmer", TRUE ~ Livelihood_x),
         Livelihood = as.factor(Livelihood)) %>% 
  select(-Fisher, -Farmer, -Fisher_farmer, -Other_livelihood, -Livelihood_x)
  
# Number of meals per household
df_hous <- df_cons %>%
  filter(Meal != "Snack") %>%
  group_by(Questionnaire, Day, Meal) %>% 
  summarize(N_food_items= n(), .groups = 'drop') %>% 
  group_by(Questionnaire) %>%
  summarize(N_meals = n()) %>% 
  right_join(df_hous, by = "Questionnaire")

# Average diet diversity per household
df_hous <- df_cons %>%
  filter(!Meal == "Snack") %>% 
  group_by(Questionnaire, Food_type) %>% 
  summarise(N_products = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  group_by(Questionnaire) %>% 
  summarise(N_products = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  right_join(df_hous, by = "Questionnaire") %>% 
  mutate(Diet_diversity = N_products/N_meals)

# Compute average per capita fish consumption per meal
df_hous <- df_cons %>%
  left_join(select(df_hous, Questionnaire, N_meals), by = "Questionnaire") %>% 
  mutate(Fish_quantity = ifelse(Food_type %in% c("Fish", "Dry fish"), Food_quantity/(N_adults+N_children), 0)) %>% 
  group_by(Questionnaire, Day, Meal) %>% 
  summarize(Fish_quantity_meal = sum(Fish_quantity), .groups = 'drop') %>% 
  group_by(Questionnaire) %>% 
  summarize(Fish_quantity_average = mean(Fish_quantity_meal, na.rm=T)*3*365) %>% 
  right_join(df_hous, by = "Questionnaire")

# Boxplot fish consumption per village
df_hous %>% ggplot(., aes(x = Barangay, y = Fish_quantity_average, fill = Barangay)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = .6) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = .3, width = .2) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Fish consumption (kg/capita/year)", fill = "Village") +
  scale_fill_fish_d(option = "Balistapus_undulatus") +
  theme_minimal()

tapply(df_hous$Fish_quantity_average, df_hous$Barangay, mean)
##    Batas    Depla   Mabini Sandoval  Silanga 
## 48.58957 50.13135 46.21794 51.89779 48.04338
summary(aov(Fish_quantity_average ~ Barangay, data = df_hous)) # p=0.524
##              Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)
## Barangay      4   1244   310.9   0.245  0.912
## Residuals   333 421715  1266.4
# Fish consumption per season
df_hous %>% ggplot(., aes(x = Season, y = Fish_quantity_average, fill = Season)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = .6) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = .3, width = .2) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Fish consumption (kg/capita/year)", fill = "Season") +
  scale_fill_fish_d(option = "Lepomis_megalotis") +
  theme_minimal()

tapply(df_hous$Fish_quantity_average, df_hous$Season, mean)
##   Amihan  Habagat 
## 47.69955 53.68245
summary(aov(Fish_quantity_average ~ Season, data = df_hous)) # p=0.524
##              Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)
## Season        1   2028    2028   1.619  0.204
## Residuals   336 420931    1253
# Computing average fish origin per household
df_hous <- df_cons %>%
  filter(Food_type %in% c("Fish", "Dry fish"),
         !is.na(Food_origin)) %>%
  group_by(Questionnaire) %>% 
  summarize(Fish_origin_average = mean(Food_origin, na.rm=T), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  right_join(df_hous, by = "Questionnaire")

# Boxplot fish origin per village
df_hous %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Fish_origin_average)) %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x = Barangay, y = Fish_origin_average, fill = Barangay)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = .6) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = .3, width = .2) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Fish origin", fill = "Barangay") +
  scale_fill_fish_d(option = "Lepomis_megalotis") +
  theme_minimal()

tapply(df_hous$Fish_origin_average, df_hous$Barangay, mean, na.rm=T)

# GLM fish consumption
fishcons_glm <- glm(Fish_quantity_average ~ N_household + Livelihood + Barangay + Season, data = df_hous)
summary(fishcons_glm)

## AIC: -11.442
## 
## Number of Fisher Scoring iterations: 2
plot_model(dd_glm)

7. Estimation of fish productivity

# Estimating mean CPUE per gear and per village
df_prod <- df_sessions %>%
  filter(!Gear == "Blast") %>% 
  group_by(Gear) %>% 
  summarize(Gear_CPUE = mean(Capture_kg, na.rm=T), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(Gear_CPUE = case_when(Gear == "Fish corral" ~ Gear_CPUE/7,
                               TRUE ~ Gear_CPUE)) # Fish corral CPUE is divided by 7 as fishers usually wait for about a week before catching the fish, in particular for larger catch


# Calculating total gear effort and productivity per village
df_prod <- df_fishers %>% 
  filter(Method_1 != "Alimasag" | is.na(Method_1)) %>% 
  mutate(Fishing_days = case_when(is.na(Gear_2) ~ Fishing_days,
                                  !is.na(Gear_2) & is.na(Gear_3) ~ Fishing_days/2,
                                  !is.na(Gear_3) ~ Fishing_days/3)) %>%  # Dividing fishing efforts for fishers with several gears
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Gear_1, Gear_2, Gear_3), names_to = "Gear_no", values_to = "Gear") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Gear)) %>% 
  group_by(Barangay, Gear) %>%
  summarize(Effort = sum(Fishing_days)/2, .groups = 'drop') %>% # Divided by two for the average between two years
  left_join(df_prod, by = c("Gear")) %>% 
  mutate(Productivity_gear = Effort*Gear_CPUE*52.143) %>%  # Productivity per gear per year
  group_by(Barangay) %>% 
  summarize(Productivity_total = sum(Productivity_gear, na.rm=T), .groups = 'drop')

# Adding population per barangay (2020 PSA census of population and housing)
df_prod$Population <- c(1220, 1274, 1698, 1355, 1587)

# Average fish consumption per village
df_prod$Fish_consumption <- tapply(df_hous$Fish_quantity_average, df_hous$Barangay, mean)[2]
df_prod$Consumption_total <- df_prod$Population*df_prod$Fish_consumption
df_prod$Balance <- df_prod$Productivity_total-df_prod$Consumption_total

8 Analyzes on the origin of fish consumed

# Origin of fish consumed for each Barangay (categories)
df_cons %>% 
  filter(Food_type %in% c("Fish", "Dry fish")) %>%
  group_by(Season, Barangay) %>% 
  count(Food_origin, name = "N") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Food_origin)) %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x = Barangay, y = N, fill = Food_origin)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
  facet_wrap(vars(Season)) +
  labs(x = "", y ="Food origin") +
  theme_minimal()

# Origin of fish consumed for each Barangay (mean origin)
df_cons %>% 
  filter(Food_type %in% c("Fish", "Dry fish"),
         !is.na(Food_origin)) %>%
  group_by(Season, Barangay) %>% 
  summarise(Food_origin_SE = sd(Food_origin)/sqrt(n()),
            Food_origin = mean(Food_origin), .groups = "drop") %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x = Barangay, y = Food_origin, fill = Season)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Food_origin-Food_origin_SE, ymax = Food_origin+Food_origin_SE),
                width = .2, position = position_dodge(.9)) +
  labs(x = "", y ="Food origin") +
  theme_minimal()
